content.title: Nobody's Cave
content.theme: Bronze-age firelight and salt wind: a cave sealed by a stone no man can move, and one lie that can.
content.premise: You are the captain, and the ships lie beached below. Your crew wanted the cheese and the lambs and a clean run back to the oars; you wanted to see the man who milked them. Now the flock is inside, the stone is across the mouth, and the man is not a man. He has eaten one of yours already. There is an olive beam in the pens, a fire in the hearth, and a name you have not yet given him. Sharpen the one, harden it in the other, and choose the name well — it is the only weapon in this cave that will still be working after the stone rolls back.
